_about: The patch program of the reference estate. The baselines mirror AWS Systems Manager Patch Manager objects (one OS class, its approval rules, its compliance severity). scripts/patch-baseline-register.sh refuses to register a baseline whose approved_by/approved_on pair is missing: an unapproved baseline must never reach the fleet. Sample configuration data; the dates are the real calendar.

baselines.name: AL2023-SECURITY-30D
baselines.description: Amazon Linux 2023, security and advisory updates, held 30 days for bake

reject_packages: kernel-livepatch (pinned by the platform team until the 2026-Q4 review)

baselines.name: AL2-MIGRATE-ONLY
baselines.description: End-of-life image class: updates are installed only to keep the agent alive; the migration to 2023 supersedes every other action

baselines.name: DB-AGENT-SECURITY
baselines.description: The database hosts: agent and monitoring components only, 14-day bake

reject_packages: datadog-agent (pinned to the observability standard until the platform upgrade)
